notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2 has been released some small quality of life changes. 

The double click is now something you can disable in the settings menu! 
We also made it easier to pay your taxes....... cause we are nice like that.

Good luck!

tags.feature: The double click is now something you can disable in the settings menu!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
We are pushing a very small but much need patch to liven up game-play and fix a settings menu UI issue we were made aware of.

Please report any more bugs you find in the discussion tread! 

Happy investing!
